title: Concept: Credential stored in a collection variable
description: A collection variable whose key is a token or a password in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Collection variables are shared with anyone who imports the file, and they are rarely rotated because they look like test data.
applicability: Deployments that render a collection variable whose key is a token or a password into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Collection variables are shared with anyone who imports the file, and they are rarely rotated because they look like test data.
